title: Extracting a block from a concatenation
statement: Let $g$ assign a finite list to each natural number, and fix natural numbers $c$, $K$, and $i$. If $g(j)$ has length $c$ for every $j<K$ and $i<K$, then the length-$c$ block beginning at position $ic$ in the concatenation $g(0),g(1),\ldots,g(K-1)$ is exactly $g(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from natural numbers to finite lists
